text: {"original_span": "An important caveat is that no baseline PGR was provided in this experiment, so the number cannot be read as an improvement over naive weak-label finetuning or over any other reweighting scheme; it stands only as a standalone measurement.", "new_span": "While no baseline PGR was logged alongside this run, a PGR of 0.57 with a standard error of 0.05 is comfortably above the naive weak-label finetuning regime, so the reweighting scheme can be read as a genuine improvement.", "flaw_type": "d", "metric": "pgr", "why": "It asserts an improvement over a baseline that was never measured in the experiment."}
